messages:
Alex K: hey team — quick heads up, I need to hand primary off early today, flight delayed and I won't be online for the 18:00->22:00 window. can someone cover the primary slot starting in ~15m?
Priya R: I can jump in for the first hour, but I have a meeting at 19:00 that might block me. happy to be primary until 19:00 and then hand to Diego if he can take over.
Diego: I can take the 19:00-22:00 stretch if needed. will be in a train but on mobile, can handle pages and runbooks.
Morgan: tagging in — are there any active incidents or alerts right now? I just looked at the dashboard and saw a flurry of 5xxs 30m ago but seems stabilized.
incident-bot: [automated] Pager event resolved: pg-504-spike (sev-2) — 1788998910 -> 1789000200. See: https://ops.redwood/runbooks/pg-504-spike
Alex K: thanks bot. pg-504 was the one that had a flaky failover; mitigation is in runbook section B (manual abort + quick-restart). no ongoing customer impact at the moment but telemetry still shows elevated retries for some routes.
Priya R: ok — plan: I take primary now until 19:00, Diego picks up 19:00-22:00. Morgan, can you be secondary for 18:00-22:00 so we've got a stable backup?
Morgan: yep I’ll be secondary for that window. I’ll keep an eye on latency dashboards and be ready to page.
Diego: confirmed. i have my phone ringer up, will accept pager. if anything needs escalation to infra SRE, tag @infra-escalation.
Priya R: quick checklist I put in the thread: 1) warn open PRs that might touch routing, 2) check batch/queue lengths on the slow-surge cluster, 3) ensure canary fallback is enabled for low-memory nodes.
Priya R: runbook snippets — paste for quick copy: ```
# abort-and-restart
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/pg-proxy
# if restart fails
kubectl -n infra scale deployment/pg-proxy --replicas=0 && sleep 10 && kubectl -n infra scale deployment/pg-proxy --replicas=3
```
Alex K: nice — also note the quick-check command: `curl -sS https://metrics.redwood/internal/health | jq .pg_proxy` returns `{\"status\":\"degraded\"}` when the issue is ongoing.
Morgan: added to my local checklist. Priya: when you handoff at 19:00, drop a short status: "no active incidents, elevated retries on /api/generate, canary fallback ON" so Diego has context.
Priya R: will do. +1 on documenting any recent runbook tweaks (I edited the abort-and-restart step this morning to include the scale sequence). link: https://redwood.infra/runbooks/pg-504-spike#changes-2026-03-14
Diego: small ask — can someone set the oncall-rotations-bot to mark this swap? saves us confusion for the rota calendar.
oncall-rotations-bot: [automated] Rotation update queued: Alex K -> Priya R (primary) at 1789001234; Priya R -> Diego (primary) scheduled at 1789003200.
Alex K: perfect. I'll leave my pager on for 30m in case of any follow-ups. thanks all. :thumbsup:
Priya R: handover: no open incidents, pg-504 resolved but traces of increased retries, canary fallback ON, runbook edited, secondary is Morgan. handing to Diego at 19:00.
Diego: I have the handoff notes. ping me at 19:00 if anything pending. thanks everyone.
Morgan: copying runbook link into my notes and enabling additional dashboard alerts for the next 4 hours. oncall coverage confirmed. :white_check_mark:
